title: Switch between schools
text: Got children at more than one school? Tap the school name at the top of the chat to switch — your choice is remembered, and each school keeps its own conversation.

title: Fallon and Emerald are here
text: Fallon Middle School and Emerald High School have joined — ask either of them about staff, bell schedules, lunch and allergens, clubs, athletics and the school calendar, same as Wells and Dublin High.

title: Ask about lunch and allergens
text: I can now tell you what's for lunch this week and flag allergens (wheat, egg, soy, milk, sesame, fish, tree nut, peanut, shellfish) for each dish — just ask, e.g. "what's dairy-free this week?"

title: Follow us on Instagram
text: Find us on Instagram at @dusdchat — tap the camera icon at the top of the chat.

title: More to ask about at Wells
text: I can now help with sports registration and physicals, volunteering, enrollment/registration dates, and student Google account setup.

title: More to ask about at DHS
text: I can now help with sports registration and physicals, parent organizations, enrollment/registration dates, the GATE program, and student Google account/WiFi setup.

title: Ask about DHS courses
text: You can now ask about course descriptions, prerequisites, credits, and graduation requirements — straight from the DUSD Grades 9-12 Course Catalog.
